what: The ‹Next› arrow is nudged to the right twice, poking, every 2.5s during the first third (10px → 5px → 10px) and then returns, resting still for the remaining 2/3 — a quiet nudge saying ‹tap here› (ease-in-out)

options.--fx-dur: Length of one loop (css variable), default 2.5s — raising it lengthens the pause too
options.--fx-x: Horizontal shift distance (CSS variable), default 10px — -10px for the left arrow
options.--fx-y: Vertical push distance (css variable), default 0 — 10px for a down arrow

from.where: shared.css .mk-next__arrow (arrow of the footer ‹NEXT› card — original #tsuntsun-interval 2.5s ease-in-out infinite, 10px at 8·24% · 5px at 16% · rests from 33%)
